claims.assertion: Swaruu says starseeds can sustain a positive timeline through inner identity, while imposed mass thinking can neutralize them and support a negative line.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says positive thought alone may not manifest desired results in 3D; active work is needed alongside focus.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She particularly urges practical action in response to problems.

claims.assertion: Swaruu claims the Cabal placed nanotech chips in vaccines from 1997 and links vaccine metals to programmed phone radiation and AI access to human bodies.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: Her account alleges covert technology and control.
